value.title: First Flight
value.synopsis: Kit receives a surprise package on her birthday containing The Rocketeer's helmet, which Grandpa Ambrose immediately recognizes as belonging to the famed superhero.

value.title: Pilot Error
value.synopsis: Grandpa Ambrose and Tesh help Kit with her training.

value.title: Skyway Robbery
value.synopsis: Sylvester Slapdash, disguised as the Costumed Bandit, plots to rob the Bulldog Cafe.

value.title: A Doggone Adventure
value.synopsis: Butch must rescue his new friend, Honey, the golden doodle.

value.title: Ground Control to Rocketeer
value.synopsis: Tesh gives his bike an extreme makeover that isn't as helpful as he hoped.

value.title: Save the Statue
value.synopsis: Kit, Tesh and Butch raise money to repair the statue of the original Hughesville Rocketeer.

value.title: Carnival Caper
value.synopsis: The Great Orsino and his traveling carnival show up in Hughesville to steal Kit's rocket pack.

value.title: Song Bird Soars Again
value.synopsis: Kit befriends a former pilot and helps her find the courage to fly her plane again.

value.title: Downhill Derby
value.synopsis: Kit and Tesh plan to compete in Hughesville's Downhilll Derby, but a young inventor has a villainous plan to win.

value.title: Flight Class Heroes
value.synopsis: Kit's class takes a trip to see an automatic, pilotless plane.

value.title: Hypnotic Hughesville
value.synopsis: When the Great Orsino hypnotizes everyone in Hughesville, the Rocketeer must find a way to wake them.

value.title: The Piggy Bank Caper
value.synopsis: Sylvester Slapdash steals Kit's piggy bank in search of a special coin.

value.title: X-Treme Hero
value.synopsis: The Rocketeer introduces Tesh to his extreme sports idol Xena Treme after rescuing her during a snowboarding competition.

value.title: Hot on the Trail
value.synopsis: Kit joins Tesh, his dad, and their Hughesville Trailbazer troop on a hike to the famed Gemstone Firefall waterfall. Once there, they must stop Laura and Harley from stealing the precious gemstone that lies within.

value.title: Valerie the Valkyrie
value.synopsis: Feeling that the Rocketeer is stealing her thunder, Valerie creates her own superhero identity called The Valkyrie.

value.title: Follow that Bulldog
value.synopsis: Cast-Iron Chef attempts to steal Kit’s family cookbook from the Bulldog Café.

value.title: Recipe for Disaster
value.synopsis: When Kit and Sareena refuse to expose the secret ingredients in their renowned family recipes, Cast-Iron Chef tries to steal them

value.title: The Critter Gang
value.synopsis: Kit investigates a string of robberies across Hughesville that seem to be committed by wild animals.

value.title: Cleared for Takeoff
value.synopsis: Kit volunteers at the Bulldog Cafe in order to prove she's responsible enough to enroll in the Valkyrie Flight School;

value.title: First Class
value.synopsis: Kit befriends Valeri d'Avion, the coolest girl in class.

value.title: Underground Doodlebug
value.synopsis: The Rocketeer goes underground to track down a mischievous kid inventor.

value.title: Bruce Goose
value.synopsis: When a baby goose bonds with Butch, the Rocketeer teaches it to fly and reunites it with its family.
